# Governance

This repository is maintained under the governance framework of buildingSMART International (bSI).

The purpose of this repository is to support the development and maintenance of buildingSMART standards, specifications, and related implementation resources in an open and transparent manner.

Final authority for standardisation, publication, and release of official buildingSMART deliverables rests with buildingSMART International through its established governance structure.

## Decision Making

> [!WARNING]
> This section requires further work.

Changes to the openBIM standards are generally developed through the following process:

* Proposal submitted through an issue.
* Solution or change proposal submitted through a pull request (author(s) must sign CLA).
* Open community discussion and technical review.
* Consensus sought among contributors and maintainers.
* If needed, escalation to the relevant buildingSMART group.
* If approved, inclusion in a candidate version.
* Official, final releases require following the buildingSMART Process with adequate committees voting.

The process differs for services and auxiliary repositories.

## Further Information

For information about buildingSMART governance, programs, and standards development processes, visit the official website:
https://www.buildingsmart.org
